sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the supplied PC6/PC7 bulbous-bow applicability, exact inclusive fa=0.6 and AR=1.3 operands, ship ownership, MN-to-kN conversion, max(iii, iv) comparison direction, and derived-result tolerance. The direct-calculation query uses permitted arithmetic and piecewise operations without unconstrained pass logic.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The applicable branch does not faithfully encode that bowDesignForce is determined according to I2.3.2.1(iv): it only checks that the reported result is at least both method values, permitting arbitrary values greater than the iv result. Model bowDesignForce as the applicable iv result, or as the required max of the iv result and the iii result when that is the verified interpretation, using the permitted derived-value tolerance rather than an unconstrained lower-bound-only check. Preserve the existing ship target, PC6/PC7 plus bulbous-bow applicability, and exact inclusive operand constants fa=0.6 and AR=1.3.

Repair the derived-result comparison. Preserve the applicable PC6/PC7 plus bulbous-bow branch, exact inclusive fa=0.6 and AR=1.3 operand constants, ship ownership, and the max(iii, iv) direction from the prior feedback. The current query computes the expected maximum in MN but compares the reported result in kN, while its tolerance remains in MN, so the bound is dimensionally wrong; convert the expected value and the tolerance to kN before comparing. Also replace both non-registered ABS calls with permitted direct arithmetic/simple piecewise branches (or an equivalent registered formulation), since DIRECT_CALCULATION permits only the explicitly listed operations.

The candidate faithfully encodes the supplied PC6/PC7 bulbous-bow applicability, exact inclusive fa=0.6 and AR=1.3 operands, ship ownership, MN-to-kN conversion, max(iii, iv) comparison direction, and derived-result tolerance. The direct-calculation query uses permitted arithmetic and piecewise operations without unconstrained pass logic.
